rationale: The discourse has matured into a clear quantified framework, but the core clash remains unresolved: labour, state, and works council still reject closures and compulsory redundancies as baseline tools, while management, family, and investors insist those options remain available if needed. The expert input narrows the debate but does not settle whether hybrid savings are sufficient at plant level, so further rounds could still change the outcome once the plant-by-plant model is tested.
